bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Juno/Bitso documents MXNB issuance and redemption through issuer APIs and lists MXNB on Arbitrum as an issuer stablecoin rather than a wrapped bridge asset. No separate bridge protocol was verified, so the route is reviewed as issuer-native mint/redeem across supported chains.
